fields.name: username
fields.help: Xandr / Microsoft Advertising platform API user name (an API-enabled user created through the API Onboarding Process).

fields.name: password
fields.help: Password of that API user. POST /auth {auth: {username, password}} returns a token valid for 2 hours after the last call (24-hour hard expiry); the runtime re-authenticates on expiry or 401 (the API allows 10 successful logins per 5 minutes).

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: Advertiser id that owns the line items; required for pause_resume (PUT /line-item?id=…&advertiser_id=…).

me.note: GET /user?current ('View the current user') with `Authorization: <token>` (no scheme).

list_accounts.note: GET /advertiser?start_element=0&num_elements=100 ('View all of your advertisers'); the first 100 advertisers (the vocabulary's list_accounts takes no page argument), total in `total`.

list_campaigns.note: GET /line-item?advertiser_id=…&start_element&num_elements — line items are the buying unit that carries state and budget (campaigns under augmented line items are generated). `status` filters on state (active / inactive). Budgets live on raw.budget_intervals (seamless line items) or raw.daily_budget (legacy), in the line item's currency, so `budget` is not mapped.

not_offered.get_report: Reporting is asynchronous: 'POST the report request to the Report Service', then poll 'GET https://api.appnexus.com/report?id=REPORT_ID' until execution_status is ready and download from report-download (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/report-service); one adapter call cannot request, poll and download.
not_offered.update_budget: Seamless line items keep daily budgets per billing period: 'If you use budget_intervals, the following fields should not be used on the line-item object: … daily_budget' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/line-item-service), so a budget change must target a specific budget_intervals element by id, which the vocabulary's campaign_id + daily_budget cannot address.
